how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stonetalon-mountains-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6461:obj:0: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.
rows.quest:6461:details:0: We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.
rows.quest:6461:details:1: BLately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.
rows.quest:6461:details:2: BIf you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
rows.quest:6461:completion:0: Sweet, mon! Good news, perhaps we will have fewer unwanted dinner guests tonight.⟦1⟧⟦2⟧Many thanks, ⟦3⟧. We are forever in your debt.
rows.quest:6481:obj:0: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
rows.quest:6481:details:0: You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, ⟦4⟧. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.
rows.quest:6481:details:1: BI have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.
rows.quest:6481:details:2: BWhen awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, ⟦5⟧!
rows.quest:6481:completion:0: You bear good news, ⟦6⟧! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:6481:completion:1: BSlaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and ⟦E1⟧ are indebted to you, noble ⟦7⟧.
rows.quest:6481:completion:2: BAccept this as your reward most honored one.
rows.quest:6523:obj:0: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.⟦8⟧
rows.quest:6523:details:0: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
rows.quest:6523:details:1: BMy father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
rows.quest:6523:completion:0: Kaya is alive! ⟦9⟧, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
rows.quest:6542:obj:0: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:6542:details:0: Have you ever been to ⟦E3⟧, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
rows.quest:6542:details:1: BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern ⟦E2⟧, at the watch tower. He is heading up the ⟦E3⟧ campaign and can give you further orders.⟦10⟧
rows.quest:6542:completion:0: ⟦E3⟧ is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
rows.quest:6548:obj:0: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.⟦11⟧
rows.quest:6548:details:0: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
rows.quest:6548:details:1: B⟦12⟧, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.
rows.quest:6548:completion:0: ⟦13⟧, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
rows.quest:6629:obj:0: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.⟦14⟧
rows.quest:6629:details:0: ⟦15⟧, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.
rows.quest:6629:details:1: BYou will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:6629:completion:0: Grundig Darkcloud is dead! ⟦17⟧, I will always be grateful for what you've done here today.
